output.summary: The packet addresses the user's primary concerns regarding IP ownership. Clause 8.1 explicitly excludes personal open-source libraries and off-hours/personal hardware tooling. Furthermore, Clause 8.3 specifically carves out 'TraceLite (Apache-2.0 distributed tracing library)' in Exhibit A, directly satisfying the user's constraints regarding both the library and personal development work.
key_claims: PIIA Clause 8.1 excludes personal open-source libraries and off-hours tooling.
PIIA Clause 8.3 explicitly lists 'TraceLite (Apache-2.0 distributed tracing library)' as carved-out prior IP.
The agreement covers inventions created using Company equipment, facilities, trade secrets, or during paid working hours.
